{"id":1588049646,"question_id":2888,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743076180,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1588049646/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Index of a Valid Split","memory":"89.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumIndex(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int majority = -1;\n        int count = 0;\n        //getting the maximum element that is present in the array\n        for(int i = 0 ;i<nums.size() ;i++)\n        {\n            if(count == 0)\n            {\n                majority = nums[i];\n                count = 1;\n            }\n            else if(majority == nums[i])\n            {\n                count++;\n            }\n            else\n                count--;\n        }\n     //getting the count of the maximum present element of the array\n        int maj_count = 0;\n        for(int  i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == majority)\n            {\n                maj_count++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        int prefix_count = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == majority)\n            {\n                prefix_count++;\n                maj_count--;\n            }\n        \n            int left_size = i+1;\n            int right_size = n-i-1;\n\n            if(prefix_count > left_size/2 && maj_count > right_size/2)\n            {\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n    return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-index-of-a-valid-split","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":502}
